[Medline](https://www.medline.com/) makes and sends out over 300,000 medical and surgical products. These items go to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, and homes. Well-known goods include exam gloves, surgical gowns, incontinence briefs, advanced wound care gauze, and durable medical equipment like wheelchairs. They also produce familiar consumer brands like Curad bandages and Venom Steel gloves. [](https://www.medline.com/)

- **Patient Care:** Bedding, mattresses, incontinence pads, and bathing systems.

- **Protection & Apparel:** Exam gloves, face masks, protective gowns, and scrub apparel.

- **Wound & Skin Care:** Advanced dressings, cleansers, tape, and specialized skin creams.

- **Mobility & Equipment:** Wheelchairs, walkers, heel boots, and orthopedic soft goods.

- **Surgical & Lab:** Surgical trays, anesthesia tools, and general laboratory supplies. [](https://www.medline.com/)

Medline's Product Offerings & Focus Areas
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Offers integrated Bluetooth-enabled vital signs monitors, connected scales, and blood pressure cuffs that sync patient vitals directly into electronic health records (EHR) or virtual care platforms for managing chronic conditions like heart failure and diabetes.
Medline Newsroom
Blood Glucose Testing:
Offers traditional blood glucose meters (such as the EvenCare G2 Bluetooth system) and lancets rather than sub-dermal continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors.
Medline At Home
Wearables:
Supplies basic digital heart rate and pedometer watches for fitness tracking, but does not make medical-grade wearable ECG smartwatches or dedicated sleep-tracking rings.
